mechanism: Both drugs cause significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia), with additive renal impairment and mineral metabolism disruption.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) and serum electrolytes closely; ensure adequate hydration with amphotericin B; consider alternative antifungal if possible; space dosing and assess risk-benefit ratio.
